title: HDO worker result
description: Minimal structured output produced by an implement or fix worker. Exit status, actual model, diff, validation logs, and artifact paths are measured and attached by the orchestrator.

changedFiles.description: Worker-reported repository-relative paths. The orchestrator independently derives the authoritative list from git diff.

tests.description: Human-readable test or validation claims. The orchestrator runs trusted project gates independently.

blockers.description: Empty means the worker reports no blocker; field absence must not be treated as an empty list.
